changes.summary: Generate and verify open and closed issue records from a versioned default or consumer-owned override while keeping tracker actions and product workflow consumer-owned.
Require delegated agents and reviewers to preserve the active user-selected model and reasoning effort, with native runtime confirmation on spawn and resume and no autonomous model changes.

Opt into publication checks at lifecycle start and completion, with pinned source metadata in version 2 receipts and exact PR head/body checks before readiness; existing consumers and version 1 receipts remain supported.
Resolve bare child commands through the invoking Python environment in fresh sessions, preserving installed dependencies, declared argument arrays, explicit executables and environment filtering.
